content:
In the world of outsourcing and remote work, it’s not common to see a virtual assistant stay with the same client for ten years. Short-term contracts and quick turnovers are often the norm.

At Virtual Office Angels, however, long-term partnerships are our top priority. This year, we proudly join Ivy as she celebrates her 10-year anniversary as a virtual assistant with our company, marking a decade of continuous service not only with us but also with the same client throughout that time.

More than just a work anniversary, Ivy’s story reflects what Virtual Office Angels stands for: finding the perfect match, building trust over time, and achieving lasting outcomes.

It’s a milestone that highlights the value of professionalism, reliability, and commitment in the virtual assistance industry.

It All Began in 2015

Ivy joined Virtual Office Angels in 2015, back when our company was still growing and refining its systems. Like many professionals entering the virtual assistance space, she was looking for more than just a remote gig.

She wanted a real career. One that would allow her to develop her skills, contribute meaningfully to a business, and build long-term professional relationships. From the outset, Ivy’s mindset was about growth and stability rather than short-term freelancing.

After going through VOA’s thorough recruitment and interview process, Ivy’s background quickly stood out. She had solid experience in administration, finance, and customer support, exactly the kind of mix many businesses need.

It didn’t take long for the team to match her with a client whose operational needs aligned closely with her skill set. That careful matching proved to be the right choice, laying the foundation for a partnership that has now lasted a full decade.

A Decade with One Client

Since 2015, Ivy has supported the same client, growing alongside their business and taking on responsibilities far beyond basic admin work. Over the years, her role has expanded tremendously. Today, Ivy independently handles a variety of critical functions for her client, including:

  • Accounts management – keeping financial records in order and up to date.
  • Customer correspondence – responding to customer inquiries and communications professionally.
  • Invoicing and payment follow-ups – ensuring the business’s billing and payments run smoothly.
  • Operational coordination – helping coordinate day-to-day operations so nothing falls through the cracks.

All of these tasks require a high degree of trust, accuracy, and consistency. Ivy has proven she can deliver on all fronts.

Her client has come to deeply appreciate her professionalism, attention to detail, and reliability. Whether she’s balancing the books or replying to a customer email, Ivy approaches each task with care and precision.

This dependable performance, especially in sensitive areas like finance and customer relations, has earned her a level of trust that few achieve.

It’s no accident that this partnership has endured for ten years. Such longevity happens only when a virtual assistant is treated as a true extension of the client’s business, rather than as a temporary helper.

Ivy has become an integral part of her client’s team, and that mutual respect and commitment have kept the relationship strong year after year.

Growing with Virtual Office Angels

Looking back on her early days at Virtual Office Angels, Ivy recalls a company that, while smaller then, had a very strong support system from team leaders and managers. That supportive culture meant she never felt like she was on her own.

Our service model is very much about support and continuous development. Virtual assistants aren’t left to fend for themselves or figure everything out solo. Instead, they are backed by dedicated team leaders, performance monitoring, and ongoing opportunities.

Let’s Start Working Together

Ivy’s 10-year journey is a testament and reflection of Virtual Office Angel’s values on long-term partnerships and quality services.

We believe that successful outsourcing relationships start with getting the match right from the very beginning. That means taking the time to deeply understand a client’s needs and carefully pairing them with a virtual assistant whose skills, experience, and communication style align perfectly with the client’s workflow and company culture.

As Virtual Office Angels continues to grow, stories like Ivy’s remain at the heart of what we do. Here’s to more years of success together!
